response.sql: WITH player_averages AS (SELECT bp.player_id, p.bats AS batting_hand, AVG(bp."double") AS average_doubles FROM batting_postseason AS bp JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = bp.player_id GROUP BY bp.player_id, p.bats), indexed AS (SELECT player_id, batting_hand, average_doubles, average_doubles / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(average_doubles) FROM player_averages), 0) AS relative_index FROM player_averages), gaps AS (SELECT player_id, batting_hand, average_doubles, relative_index, relative_index - AVG(relative_index) OVER (PARTITION BY batting_hand) AS gap FROM indexed) SELECT player_id, batting_hand, average_doubles, relative_index AS "index", gap FROM gaps ORDER BY gap IS NULL, gap DESC, player_id LIMIT 10;
